class: A change that recomputes a figure which a shared computation already produces passes every local test and a reviewer's 'cost unchanged' reading, because the result is identical; only a test that counts how many times the work is done sees it.
mechanism: The entry-guide line computed option deltas a second time instead of reading the shared computation; outputs matched, so correctness tests stayed green, and the cost doubled until a performance test failed on the whole check.

first_seen.where: GC-ICFIX guided builder change, repaired in 0ebcdaea
first_seen.evidence: a performance regression failed in the full local check on the combined head; the repair reads the deltas from the shared computation

fix: Give a shared figure one computation and assert by a counting test (work done, not seconds) that a new reader does not repeat it; answer a reviewer's 'cost unchanged' with that test.

detection.note: Caught only by the existing performance test on the whole check; no per-figure count test exists yet.
